thread:
maya: quick RFC follow-up: prototyped a local observer service that can make low-latency fallback decisions during canary / A-B rollouts. posting notes for ops + SRE review.
jon: what's the core split vs central controller?
maya: central remains the source of truth for rollout intent and weights. observer handles short-circuit local actions (evict variant on node, route-new-sessions to baseline, soft-degrade) to avoid roundtrip delay.
alex: what signals will it use? infra only?
maya: infra (p95 latency, 5xx rate) + tiny golden-prompt evals (5 samples). signals chosen to be cheap and fast.
rachel: how do we prevent flapping?
maya: policy includes hysteresis, per-rollout lease tokens, and N-of-M cohort agreement for global escalation. local mitigations are TTL-bound.
jon: show policy sketch?
maya: small example used in staging: rollout_id=r-2026-03-21-42; signals: latency_p95(threshold_ms=1200,window=60,hysteresis=30), error_rate(threshold_pct=0.5,window=120); action: local=route_fallback, global_escalate_after=3.
alex: route_fallback meaning proxy sends new sessions to baseline locally. cache/prefix mismatch risk?
rachel: prefer soft routing (new sessions) to avoid cold KV cache churn. avoid evicting prefix cache if possible.
maya: observer exposes /v1/decision returning action, reason, ttl. proxies poll 5s and apply hints; TTL ensures auto-revert if observer dies.
jon: observability plan? decision lineage?
maya: attach decision_id header, surface decision->signals->cohort votes in console, and emit metrics (decisions/sec, avg_ttl, rollback_count).
sre-lead: ops: must allow per-namespace opt-out and a global kill-switch. some customers require central-only.
maya: agreed. observer mode configurable per-rollout: advisory or active. advisory = suggest-only.
jon: conflict resolution? central veto path?
maya: central controller can post a cancel token; otherwise observer decisions are authoritative for TTL.
alex: failure modes? if observer crashes do not auto-rollback.
maya: fail-open to central-only (no automatic eviction on observer failure).
deploy-bot: deploy planned: observer v0.3 -> staging eu-west-1 (build 20260321.85).
rachel: request advisory run for 1 week at 10% canaries before active.
maya: plan: advisory 10% -> 1 week -> active for cohorts if stable. will draft oncall runbook for reverting decisions and tracing. thanks :thumbsup:
